name: Bulk EXIF Viewer and Stripper

seo.title: Bulk EXIF Viewer and Stripper — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Inspect common EXIF metadata across local images, then create metadata-stripped copies without uploading originals.

assumptions: Metadata removal is performed on newly encoded output; originals are never modified.
limitations: Re-encoding can change compression and colour-profile metadata; metadata stripping is not a forensic anonymity guarantee.
